newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian officials seize 70 kg of heroin.
newsitem.headline: Indian officials seize 70 kg of heroin.

text.p: Indian revenue officials halted two trucks near the capital on Saturday and seized 70 kg (154 lb) of heroin with an estimated street price of 700 million rupees ($19.5 million), the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.

The news agency, quoting sources in the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI), said the officials intercepted the trucks and seized 34 packets of the narcotic concealed in the diesel tank of one truck and 35 packets from the other.
Four people were arrested, it said.
Preliminary investigations revealed that the contraband drug entered India from the Pakistani border through the northern state of Punjab and had been destined to be smuggled to the west, PTI said.
